name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Local stdio MCP: automate Chrome (tabs, snapshots, screenshots, console, network). Runs the copy pinned and shipped with Vodou; usage statistics off.

setupSteps.title: Prerequisites
setupSteps.instructions: Install Google Chrome (or Edge, Brave or Chromium). The server itself ships with Vodou — nothing to download.

setupSteps.title: Add server
setupSteps.instructions: Click Add server below. Vodou runs vodou-core connect chrome-devtools … with the copy pinned in MCP-servers/chrome-devtools-mcp.
setupSteps.gotcha: If tools stay at 0, use Test connection after enabling the server under Capabilities.

setupSteps.title: Enable in Tools
setupSteps.instructions: Open Capabilities → MCP Servers and turn chrome-devtools on so chat can call its tools.
